description: The benchmarks BenchLeader reads: what each measures, publisher, category, whether it feeds the Index (and its weight), how many models it covers, status and caveats. Filter by category or a search query. Paged.

category.description: Only this category, e.g. coding, agentic, reasoning, math, knowledge.

in_index_only.description: Only benchmarks that feed the BenchLeader Index.

limit.description: How many benchmarks to return (at most 100).

offset.description: Rows to skip, for paging (use next_offset from the previous page).

query.description: Search benchmark names, ids, aliases and publishers ("swe-bench", "arc", "epoch").

name: list_benchmarks
title: List benchmarks
